meta.name: Day 18 crossover index database
meta.note: Counts are snapshots from 25 Nov 2026 and approximate. Nothing here has been validated as a prediction.

methodology.goal: A global top 100 of the most popular people, ranked first on crossover relevance from 12 months of press coverage.

scope.categories: none in the list; Guardian sections are used internally to measure crossover only

steps.name: Seed the candidates by followers
steps.detail: Take the most-followed people, not a curated list. Current seed is Wikipedia's list of most-followed Instagram accounts with brand accounts (Instagram, Nike) removed. A cross-platform combined list was not available: the Backlinko page redirected and returned a 403.

steps.name: Pull 12 months of press
steps.detail: Guardian Content API, window 2025-11-25 to 2026-11-25. Record each article's section and publish date, count by section and month, cache every page locally.
steps.api_limits: Developer key: 1 call per second, 500 calls per day, non-commercial use only.

steps.name: Score crossover relevance only
steps.detail: Home section is the section with the most articles for that person. Breadth is the number of other sections with at least 3 articles. Outside share is the share of articles outside the home section. Rank by breadth, break ties with outside share. Show volume beside the score but keep it out of the score so fame alone cannot win.

steps.name: Rank the top 10 first, then widen to 100
steps.detail: Work through the top ten people by followers, then extend the same method down the seed list.

matching_options.status: tested, works, but counts too small to score most people

matching_options.detail: Articles the Guardian has tagged as about the person, for example music/taylor-swift. Needs one tag lookup per name; some people may have no tag.
Full-text search with a higher per-section threshold to filter passing mentions.
matching_options.status: fallback for people without a tag

methodology.hypothesis: A person's ability to cross into other industries is the biggest factor in how famous they become. Not tested yet: needs an outcome measure independent of press, a stalled-controls group, and timestamped rankings checked over time.
caveats: Guardian coverage reflects UK and US editorial choices.
Follower totals vary by source and date, so treat them as approximate.
Tags may have been added to older articles after publication.
A public index built on Guardian content probably needs the commercial key or the Guardian's permission; check before publishing.
Sections overlap, and many of the 82 are network or regional sections.

seed.source: Wikipedia, List of most-followed Instagram accounts (brand accounts removed)
not_in_seed_but_seen_elsewhere: MrBeast (leads YouTube, second on combined-follower lists)

press_counts_12_months.source: Guardian Content API search, headline field only, phrase match on full name
press_counts_12_months.finding: Six of the ten have too few headline matches to reach 3 articles in any other section, so headline-only cannot score them. Short-name matches are higher but can hit other people.

case_study_taylor_swift.purpose: Benchmark for how breadth looks over time, not evidence for the hypothesis. Famous before Instagram, so not a creator-origin case.
case_study_taylor_swift.method: Guardian articles tagged music/taylor-swift, all dates

baskets.design: Three owned indicators and one rented indicator per vertical, plus a shared press and crossover layer. Owned space is weighted above rented. Weights are not set yet.

rented.data: followers public, engagement per post, scraping restricted

owned.indicator: Direct-to-fan channels (mailing list, Bandcamp, fan club)

rented.indicator: Streaming and short-form (Spotify monthly listeners, TikTok sound use)
Resale and rental activity (Depop, Vinted, By Rotation): followers, ratings, sell-through

shared_layer.indicator: Press coverage by Guardian section (breadth, speed, persistence)
Number of sections and baskets entered over time

watchlist_fashion_platforms.note: Apps named in 2025 and 2026 coverage. A watch list, not a basket: no public follower or creator counts found. Details come from search summaries, not from reading the articles.
